title: Forwarding call decomposition
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be an anchor state of $B$, and choose an output prefix, startup marker, configuration $c$ of $B$ on a Boolean input, release bit, optional flag bit, Boolean word, and configuration of $F$ on that input. The forwarding call equals the capturing call built from the configuration obtained by replacing the output of $c$ by the empty word, with the resulting configuration's physical output replaced by the prefix followed by the original output of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $B,F$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
The prefix and word are Boolean words
The startup marker and release bit are Boolean
$c$ is a configuration of $B$ on a Boolean input
The flag is an optional Boolean
The fuel configuration is a configuration of $F$ on the same input
replaced:
For every output prefix $p$, startup marker, body configuration $c$, release bit, flag
bit, counter word, and fuel configuration: the forwarding call equals the corresponding
capturing call built on $c$ with its output removed, with physical output replaced by
$p$ followed by the output of $c$. The identity is between configurations only.
